response.sql: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) AS t) AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_count DESC LIMIT 10
